description.value: Bednesti Lake Resort is a seasonal, gated RV park situated on Bednesti Lake, 30 minutes west of Prince George along Hwy 16 west. The resort offers waterfront sites, fishing, and beach access in a scenic Central Interior setting. OSM tags suggest a restaurant and convenience store may be located on-site, but this is not corroborated by the resort's own website.

address.value: 42765 Hwy 16 W, Prince George, BC V2N 6P4
